assumptions: The requirement has no explicit rule for volatility states below the Tier-2 circuit-breaker threshold; assumed such orders proceed without queuing (BR-8).
The $1,000,000 threshold in 'orders above $1,000,000 USD' is assumed to be exclusive, so an order of exactly $1,000,000 does not require dual-authorization (BR-6).
Dual-authorization is assumed to require two distinct authorized approvers, since the requirement does not define the authorization mechanics (BR-7).

The requirement does not specify field-level validation rules (required fields, formats) for order submission; a generic validation scenario (SC-13) is included as a reasonable inference, not a stated rule.
No prompt-injection or instruction-like content was found embedded in the requirement text; the document was treated purely as data.
SC-9 (settlement duration approaching/exceeding the 250ms SLA) was realized as two distinct test cases (at-boundary and over-boundary) since these are genuinely distinct timing conditions.
SC-13 (missing/malformed order fields) was realized as three distinct test cases, one per field (amount, currency code, counterparty identifier), since each is a genuinely distinct validation input.
SC-14 (cross-currency pairs) was realized as three distinct test cases (USD/EUR, USD/JPY, GBP/USD) as named in the design's rationale, since each represents a distinct data variation.

test_cases.title: Order below $1,000,000 USD settles without dual-authorization within SLA
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Market volatility is within normal (sub Tier-2) conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order valued at $500,000 USD
Observe the routing and clearing engine processing without a dual-authorization prompt
Measure the elapsed time from submission to settlement completion
test_cases.expected_result: The order settles successfully without requiring dual-authorization, completes within 250ms, and ISO 20022 pacs.008 confirmation messages are emitted to both counterparties.

test_cases.title: Order above $1,000,000 USD with valid dual-authorization settles successfully
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Two distinct authorized approvers are available to sign off on the order
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order valued at $2,500,000 USD
Obtain sign-off from two distinct authorized approvers for the order
Confirm the order is routed to the clearing engine after both approvals are recorded
Observe settlement completion
test_cases.expected_result: The order routes only after both approvals are recorded, settles successfully, and ISO 20022 pacs.008 confirmation messages are emitted to both counterparties.

test_cases.title: Order above $1,000,000 USD without dual-authorization is blocked from routing
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
No dual-authorization approvals have been obtained for the order
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order valued at $2,000,000 USD without any approver sign-off
Attempt to route the order to the clearing engine
test_cases.expected_result: The order is blocked and not routed to the clearing engine; no settlement occurs and no confirmation messages are emitted.

test_cases.title: Order rejected at lock-in due to insufficient margin balance
preconditions: Trading account margin balance is below the amount required for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Order has any required dual-authorization already satisfied
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order that requires more margin than is available in the trading account
Allow the clearing engine to perform the margin balance validation prior to lock-in
test_cases.expected_result: The order is rejected at the lock-in stage due to insufficient margin balance; the trade does not settle and no confirmation messages are emitted.

test_cases.title: Trade is not settled when bilateral counterparty risk verification fails
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty identifier submitted with the order is unrecognized or invalid
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order referencing an unrecognized or invalid counterparty identifier
Allow the clearing engine to perform bilateral counterparty risk verification
test_cases.expected_result: Bilateral counterparty risk verification fails, the trade is not settled, and no ISO 20022 confirmation messages are emitted.

test_cases.title: Order valued at exactly $1,000,000 USD does not require dual-authorization
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
No dual-authorization approvals have been obtained for the order
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order valued at exactly $1,000,000.00 USD
Attempt to route the order to the clearing engine without any approver sign-off
test_cases.expected_result: The order routes and settles without requiring dual-authorization, since the threshold rule applies only to amounts strictly above $1,000,000 USD.

test_cases.title: Order valued at $1,000,000.01 USD requires dual-authorization
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
No dual-authorization approvals have been obtained for the order
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order valued at exactly $1,000,000.01 USD
Attempt to route the order to the clearing engine without any approver sign-off
test_cases.expected_result: The order is blocked from routing because it exceeds the $1,000,000 USD threshold and dual-authorization has not been obtained.

test_cases.title: Margin balance exactly equal to the required amount allows lock-in to proceed
preconditions: Trading account margin balance is set to exactly the amount required by the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Order has any required dual-authorization already satisfied
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order whose required margin exactly matches the trading account's available margin balance
Allow the clearing engine to perform the margin balance validation prior to lock-in
test_cases.expected_result: The margin balance validation passes and lock-in proceeds, since the balance is sufficient (equal to the requirement, not below it).

test_cases.title: Settlement completing at exactly the 250ms SLA boundary is treated as compliant
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Market conditions are normal (sub Tier-2 volatility)
Test environment can simulate settlement processing latency of exactly 250ms
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order under normal market conditions
Simulate clearing engine processing such that settlement completes at exactly 250ms elapsed time
Measure the elapsed time from submission to settlement completion
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement completes within the 250ms SLA and is recorded as compliant, with confirmation messages emitted to both counterparties.

test_cases.title: Settlement exceeding the 250ms SLA under normal market conditions is flagged as an SLA breach
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Market conditions are normal (sub Tier-2 volatility)
Test environment can simulate settlement processing latency exceeding 250ms
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order under normal market conditions
Simulate clearing engine processing such that settlement completes at 251ms elapsed time
Measure the elapsed time from submission to settlement completion
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement duration exceeds the 250ms SLA under normal market conditions and is observably flagged as an SLA breach, rather than being silently accepted as on-time.

test_cases.title: Order transitions to queued settlement state when market volatility exceeds Tier-2 threshold
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Market volatility monitor reports volatility exceeding the Tier-2 circuit-breaker threshold
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order while market volatility exceeds the Tier-2 circuit-breaker threshold
Observe the clearing engine's handling of the order instead of immediate settlement or failure
test_cases.expected_result: The order automatically transitions to a queued settlement state instead of failing or completing immediately.

test_cases.title: Order proceeds normally when market volatility remains at or below Tier-1
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Market volatility monitor reports volatility at or below Tier-1 (below the Tier-2 circuit-breaker threshold)
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order while market volatility is at or below Tier-1
Observe the clearing engine's handling of the order through to settlement
test_cases.expected_result: The order proceeds through normal settlement without being transitioned to a queued settlement state.

test_cases.title: Confirmation message emitted after settlement is a well-formed ISO 20022 pacs.008 message
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Order settles successfully
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order that settles successfully
Capture the confirmation messages emitted to both counterparties
Validate each captured message against the ISO 20022 pacs.008 message schema
test_cases.expected_result: Both emitted confirmation messages are well-formed and pass validation against the ISO 20022 pacs.008 message schema.

test_cases.title: Order submission with missing trade amount is rejected before clearing checks
preconditions: Order submission form or API endpoint for trade orders is available
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order with the trade amount field omitted
Observe whether the order reaches the clearing engine's margin or counterparty checks
test_cases.expected_result: The order is rejected as invalid due to the missing trade amount before any clearing engine checks (margin validation, counterparty verification) are performed.

test_cases.title: Order submission with malformed currency code is rejected before clearing checks
preconditions: Order submission form or API endpoint for trade orders is available
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order with an invalid currency code value, e.g. 'XYZ123'
Observe whether the order reaches the clearing engine's margin or counterparty checks
test_cases.expected_result: The order is rejected as invalid due to the malformed currency code before any clearing engine checks (margin validation, counterparty verification) are performed.

test_cases.title: Order submission with missing counterparty identifier is rejected before clearing checks
preconditions: Order submission form or API endpoint for trade orders is available
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order with the counterparty identifier field omitted
Observe whether the order reaches the clearing engine's margin or counterparty checks
test_cases.expected_result: The order is rejected as invalid due to the missing counterparty identifier before any clearing engine checks (margin validation, counterparty verification) are performed.

test_cases.title: Cross-currency trade settles correctly for the USD/EUR currency pair
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for the USD/EUR currency pair valued below $1,000,000 USD
Observe processing through the clearing engine to settlement completion
test_cases.expected_result: The USD/EUR order settles successfully within the 250ms SLA and ISO 20022 pacs.008 confirmation messages are emitted to both counterparties.

test_cases.title: Dual-authorization with only one approver's sign-off is rejected as incomplete
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the order
Counterparty is recognized and passes bilateral risk verification
Order is valued above $1,000,000 USD and therefore requires dual-authorization
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order valued at $1,500,000 USD
Obtain sign-off from only a single authorized approver for the order
Attempt to route the order to the clearing engine
test_cases.expected_result: The order is rejected as having incomplete authorization and is not routed, since dual-authorization requires sign-off from two distinct authorized approvers.
